use Ghul.Pipes
use Raster.IMAGE

let width = 480
let height = 360
let sites = 24

let state mut = 1234567L

next(limit: int) -> int is
    state = (state * 1103515245L + 12345L) % 2147483648L

    return cast int(state % cast long(limit))
si

let places =
    (0..sites)
        |> map(_ =>
            (x = next(width),
             y = next(height),
             red = cast ubyte(80 + next(160)),
             green = cast ubyte(80 + next(160)),
             blue = cast ubyte(80 + next(160))))
        |> collect_list()

nearest(x: int, y: int) -> int =>
    (let best mut = 0
     let closest mut = width * width + height * height

     for at in 0..places.count do
         let across = x - places[at].x
         let up = y - places[at].y
         let away = across * across + up * up

         if away < closest then
             closest = away
             best = at
         fi
     od

     best)

let image = IMAGE(width, height)

for y in 0..height do
    for x in 0..width do
        let site = places[nearest(x, y)]

        image.set_pixel(x, y, site.red, site.green, site.blue)
    od
od

image.colour(0ub, 0ub, 0ub)

for site in places do
    image.fill([
        (x = cast double(site.x) - 3.0D, y = cast double(site.y) - 3.0D),
        (x = cast double(site.x) + 3.0D, y = cast double(site.y) - 3.0D),
        (x = cast double(site.x) + 3.0D, y = cast double(site.y) + 3.0D),
        (x = cast double(site.x) - 3.0D, y = cast double(site.y) + 3.0D)
    ])
od

image.write("voronoi.png")

image.show("voronoi.png")
